name: The living redaction
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. ONE finished 1536x1024 landscape desktop homepage hero for Perry, a Mac companion represented by a tiny ink stick figure. Original high-concept art direction, complete polished website, not a moodboard. The user loved monumental intertwined ink lettering and cursor, and a character taking a shortcut through huge script. Create an entirely NEW visual mechanism at that quality.
CONCEPT THE LIVING REDACTION: Perry physically pulls an unwanted word out of the headline. A spare, brilliant editorial page becomes a demonstration of giving away busywork.
Ultra-clean warm-white paper, black letterpress ink, SINGLE vivid tomato-red accent, almost invisible grain. Large 100px clean condensed grotesk headline spans the middle on THREE deliberate lines, exactly 'Your Mac.' then 'Your busywork.' then 'Your afternoon back.' This typography occupies most width, tightly composed like a remarkable magazine cover. The middle line 'Your busywork.' is partly covered by one giant thick matte-black brushstroke/redaction bar. Here is the extraordinary focal moment: the redaction bar is a continuous flexible ink ribbon, and its right end has been lifted OFF THE PRINTED PAGE and drawn diagonally upward by a tiny 130px Perry. The exposed area beneath shows only clean white paper: he is literally removing the busywork. The bar should cast an exquisitely subtle shadow ONLY where it lifts, with a fine rough ink edge, not a realistic fabric or plastic strap. Along the bar's lifted tail, faint reversed fragments of the removed word adhere as pale ink. The lifted ink ribbon curls into one elegant large loop at right and resolves into a small crisp computer cursor arrow, connecting this magical act to computer work. Perry stands at upper-right of the headline, feet planted, both hands gripping the ribbon, round unfilled black-ink head, TWO small vertical oval eyes, NO mouth, thin lively limbs. Warm inviting body language. One small handwritten note beside him: 'leave this bit with me.'
Quiet navigation: lowercase handwritten 'perry' upper-left. Upper-right 'Get Perry for Mac ↗' and tiny sun/moon icon. Footer area with generous whitespace, at left clean exact supporting copy 'Perry sees your screen, shows you how, and takes tasks off your hands.' At right a vivid red button with BLACK type 'Give Perry the busywork ↗', and small text 'Try a website demo'. No conventional headline-left/illustration-right layout: the words, removal, cursor and mascot form ONE integrated graphic event. Make the middle line legible enough to understand the visual joke while the redaction is mid-removal. Superb typographic hierarchy, intellectually playful, enormous scale contrast. No screenshots, app windows, feature cards, tape, physical notebooks, paper tears, 3D cartoon, robot, gradient, neon, stars or decorative scribbles. Clear actionable hero with one impossible ink behaviour.

name: The page is a Mac
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Generate an extraordinary original finished Perry website HERO, 1536x1024 landscape. Perry is a two-eyed mouthless ink stick figure helping use a Mac. Need one radical visual mechanism with an immediately tempting website demo. Avoid all conventional SaaS layouts, dashboards and embedded Finder screenshots.
CONCEPT THE PAGE IS A MAC: a giant hand-drawn Mac COMMAND KEY becomes the entire world of the hero, and the little companion physically turns the command symbol into a shortcut.
Full-bleed saturated clean COBALT BLUE print background, warm ivory and a single tiny lemon-yellow highlight. High contrast, sunny experimental Swiss/hand-ink graphic design. At center a monumental ivory COMMAND SYMBOL ⌘ fills approximately 950 by 750px. Render it as a continuous generous dry-ink stroke, with its familiar exact four-loop shape unmistakably recognisable, NOT random knotwork. It is FLAT ink on blue paper, no keycap object, no plastic, no bevel. Its lower-right loop has been gently stretched outward into a long ivory path, where a tiny ivory outline Perry balances and pulls the line toward a small yellow rectangular doorway at the right edge of the viewport. He is only 115px tall, circular unfilled head with TWO vertical oval eyes, NO mouth, minimal expressive limbs. The exact shape of the other three loops remains coherent so it reads unmistakably as the Command key. A small normal-sized cursor arrow travels along the stretched loop behind him. The SYMBOL ITSELF is the compositional architecture: left loop contains the small readable word 'ask', upper loop 'learn', right loop 'do' in simple black? NO use cobalt text where sitting on ivory; otherwise ivory text inside blue loop negative space, all extremely legible. Do not add extra explanatory boxes.
Interwoven across the open center of the command symbol, HUGE bespoke handwritten lowercase text 'take a shortcut.' in deep near-black ink, with white reversal ONLY at overlapping blue? Keep headline high contrast: use LEMON YELLOW lettering across the cobalt negative space, break naturally into two lines, no crossing that obscures reading. Lettering is expressive and confident, not a generic script font. Small ivory 'perry' upper-left, top-right 'Get Perry for Mac ↗'. Bottom-left readable 25px ivory promise 'A little help with whatever’s on your Mac.' Bottom-right a real warm-ivory action button with cobalt text 'Show me a shortcut ↗', under it 'Interactive website demo'. Tiny sun/moon control in nav.
This hero must look like a singular iconic brand poster that visitors can touch. Strong 2D screenprint craft, expertly controlled figure-ground, monumental familiar Mac symbol doing something physically impossible, extremely precise spatial composition, 25 percent open blue space. No laptop, no keycap render, no OS window, no normal app screenshot, no scattered symbols, no feature cards, no paper books, no tears, no stickers, no gradients, no glows, no fake metrics. The final result should be graphic, generous, inviting and audacious.

name: The ink weather
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE compelling original desktop website hero for Perry, a Mac companion. 1536x1024 landscape finished screenshot. The previous favourite designs used enormous living calligraphy, precise figure-ground illusion and tiny active stickman. Make an entirely new visual mechanism with a powerful, hopeful emotional hook.
CONCEPT THE INK WEATHER: a chaotic tangle of ink at the top becomes a single clear action line through Perry. The page visualises relief from computer confusion, without gloomy imagery or a stock split-screen before/after.
Canvas pristine WHITE, black print ink, one electric coral-red accent. At the top-center, an immense intricately entangled but BEAUTIFULLY COMPOSED mass of black handwritten lines occupies 55 percent of page width and 40 percent height. The tangle has only a FEW readable fragments embedded in it: 'where?', 'which menu?', 'again?'. Other marks are intentional calligraphic loops, no fake tiny gibberish. Its silhouette is sculptural and graceful, like a tightly tangled paragraph, not a storm cloud, smoke, brain, neurons, AI network or scribble wallpaper. From this complexity, one SINGLE BLACK LINE descends toward lower-right. A tiny Perry stick figure is at the junction, physically sliding a bright CORAL ring along the line like a thread guide, concentrating happily. Big unfilled circle head, exactly TWO black vertical oval eyes, no mouth, spare ink limbs, 125px tall. BELOW him the same line emerges perfectly clean and sweeps across the lower-left into one beautiful confident arrow that points directly to the call-to-action. The contrast between dense tangle and perfectly clear line is the hero composition.
The main wording is visually integrated into the open lower-middle space: monumental fluid hand-lettered 'ah. got it.' in black, 180px scale, flowing alongside the newly untangled line, not in a left text column. The enormous period is a small coral ink dot near Perry. Small handwritten 'perry' upper-left. Top-right sober 'Get Perry for Mac ↗' and sun/moon icon. Beneath the graphic, left-aligned 24px clean sans exact 'The companion that helps your Mac make sense.' Below in 18px 'Ask about your screen. Learn the steps. Hand over the task.' Lower-right clear coral-filled button with black type 'Untangle something ↗', with tiny 'Try a website demo'. A subtle hand-lettered note beside Perry says 'one thing at a time.'
Design should feel cathartic, playful and visually astonishing through density contrast, exceptional custom lettering and exact layout, not depressive. Generous breathing room in lower half, no ruled notebook, cream wash or heavy grain. NO screenshots, software panels, decorative character repeated, multiple arrows, cards, robot, neon, gradients, tape, physical notebook, popup paper, tears, logo walls or fake success claims. Ensure the black tangle is graceful intentional calligraphic art and the type is highly readable, a warm product introduction with an obvious useful action.

name: The missing piece
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Produce an inventive, meticulously art-directed Perry website HERO, one 1536x1024 landscape screenshot. Perry is a friendly little hand-inked stick-person companion who can help you use your Mac. This must feel like a bold interactive identity, not a standard marketing template. A new concept unlike cursors, shortcuts through writing, notebooks, giant command symbols or undo ribbons.
CONCEPT THE MISSING PIECE: the negative space in an enormous wordmark is alive. A huge beautiful lower-case 'perry' in custom ULTRA-BOLD BLACK grotesk spans the full width and dominates the upper two-thirds. The inside counter of the giant first 'p' is a perfectly shaped CREAM-WHITE CUTOUT that has slipped out of the letter and is being carried at lower-right by miniature Perry, leaving a solid black p-shaped letter behind. Make the whole word remain unmistakably readable as 'perry' despite the missing counter. The counter is not a generic circle: a precise large rounded inner p-shaped aperture, approximately 270px wide, 320px tall, with a fine black hand-drawn contour and absolutely minimal thickness, like a piece of negative space lifted into the same flat illustration plane. It is held at a gentle angle. As Perry carries it over the black printed area, the aperture reveals bright white; over the white page it becomes almost invisible except for its delicate ink contour. This is a sharp figure-ground optical joke, like a real hole in the ink, NOT a paper tear or peel. Through the moving aperture, at its center, a tiny unmistakable coral cursor arrow is visible, implying a portal into the desktop. Perry walks forward holding one edge with both hands, round unfilled black head, TWO vertical oval eyes, no mouth, slender limbs. Tiny handwritten note near him 'found what was missing.'
Composition: white printed page, rich matte black wordmark, SINGLE coral-red accent. Full visual authority, immaculate spacing. Brand navigation top-left very small 'Your Mac’s new companion.' Top-right 'Get Perry ↗' and a small sun/moon icon. Below giant wordmark, left-side large 45px exact headline 'Your Mac was missing someone.' Supporting 20px exact copy 'Perry sees your screen, guides your next step, and helps get the work done.' Right bottom obvious CORAL action button with BLACK text 'Meet the missing piece ↗', and small text 'Try Perry in this page'. The mascot and lifted counter connect the wordmark to this action, and the tiny cursor inside the aperture supplies the functional computer connection.
Render as a sophisticated experimental identity with precise geometry, exceptional optical balance and one charming impossible event. The visual must remain simple, witty, instantly comprehensible at a distance, delightful on closer inspection. No volumetric 3D character, no realistic paper layers, no gray shadows under every element, no sad texture, no cards, no app screenshots, no Finder, no hardware, no keycaps, no feature lists, no generic display headline beside decorative illustration. The typographic wordmark IS the stage and the negative-space counter IS the playful interaction.
